annotation.authors_or_issuer: Group of Governmental Experts on Emerging Technologies in the Area of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems, CCW
key_provisions_or_claims: No consensus reached on conclusions; Chair's summary annexed as basis for 2022 work
IHL applies fully to all weapons systems including LAWS
Humans must retain responsibility and accountability; human judgement essential
States should not develop or use LAWS that cannot comply with IHL or operate outside responsible command
Recommends legal weapon reviews, risk mitigation, and a political declaration or instrument at the Sixth Review Conference
annotation.summary_en: Report of the 2021 CCW Group of Governmental Experts on lethal autonomous weapons systems. It records organisation of work and that no consensus was reached; the Chair's summary annex proposes recommendations on IHL application, human accountability, human-machine interaction, weapon reviews, risk mitigation, and a political declaration or instrument.
